item.title: AtmosCheck 0.5
item.description:
AtmosCheck 0.5

  • Play any analyzed master from its detail view and switch what you hear while it plays: the stereo fold, the mono sum, the 5.1 re-render (on an output device with six channels), and the stereo master, time-aligned for A/B. Space plays and pauses; ⌘1–⌘4 switch.
  • A/B with the stereo master is loudness-matched by default, so the louder one does not win; the applied trim is shown.
  • Solo and mute any bed channel or object from the Channels tab to find the track behind a problem in the fold.
  • Meters for the outputs and a left/right phase correlation reading; it turns orange or red when the fold will lose level in mono.
  • Jump to the loudest passage or to the true peak from the player's menu.
  • The player has its own output device choice and never changes a device's sample rate or buffer size. The device is released whenever playback is paused.
  • The folds are AtmosCheck's own render, not Dolby's: good for hearing balance and phase problems, not a replacement for the Dolby Atmos Renderer or for a binaural check.

item.title: AtmosCheck 0.4
item.description:
AtmosCheck 0.4

  • Conform All: conform every analyzed master into a folder in one run, with a naming pattern. Tokens like {artist}, {title}, {n2} and {clean} build names such as "01 Chanell - Bassy (Dolby Atmos).wav" from the original file names. Masters that need no changes can be copied under the new name so the whole album ends up together; results are added to the list and checked.
  • Same batch from the command line: atmoscheck-cli batch <files or folder> --out-dir DIR --name PATTERN [--stereo-dir DIR].

item.title: AtmosCheck 0.3
item.description:
AtmosCheck 0.3

  • An object track with no audio is now a failure (AUD-02), because label QC rejects masters with empty tracks even though they are inaudible. Silent bed channels stay informational (AUD-03).
  • Conform can remove silent object tracks: the audio channels, the ADM description, the channel table and the Dolby metadata are all rewritten so the new master has only tracks that carry sound.

item.title: AtmosCheck 0.2
item.description:
AtmosCheck 0.2

  • No changes to the checks or the app itself. This release exercises the finished update path: installed copies of 0.1 pick it up through Check for Updates… or the weekly check.
  • Release tooling: publishing is its own re-runnable step, and the release script explains what to do when a version has no notes yet.

item.title: AtmosCheck 0.1
item.description:
AtmosCheck 0.1

  • macOS app: drop ADM BWF masters (and stereo masters) on the window, get a pass/fail report per Apple Music / Dolby rule, a channel table with binaural modes, and an album overview with cross-track checks.
  • Conform sheet: gain to the loudness ceiling, start alignment and length match against the stereo master, written as a new ADM file that is added back to the list for verification.
  • Native Swift engine (AtmosCheckKit): RIFF/RF64 reader, ADM and Dolby dbmd parsing, BS.1770-4 loudness and 4x true peak, approximate 5.1/2.0 re-render, cross-correlation sync. Matches the Python prototype's numbers on real masters and runs a 2-minute master in under a second.
  • Command line twin `atmoscheck-cli` for scripts and parity checks.
  • In-app updates through Sparkle (weekly check, AtmosCheck > Check for Updates…) and a release script that builds, tests, signs, makes the disk image and publishes.
  • Provenance check (PROV-01/02): flags Atmos masters that reconstruct the stereo master almost exactly, the signature of upmixes and de-mixed stems that label QC rejects.
